clips.title: The story
paras: Southwest of Brill, Eleanor Shackleton camps in the woods of Tirisfal Glades. This Forsaken outdoorswoman teaches travelers wilderness survival and field crafts instead of staying in town or the Undercity. Her surname is shared by other Forsaken in the region, a possible link to life before the plague.

Eleanor Shackleton camps in the haunted woods southwest of Brill, away from the Undercity. Newly awakened Forsaken often head for those settlements, but she teaches travelers how to live off Tirisfal's blighted land. Her lessons cover setting up campsites, gathering firewood, and keeping trade crafts while roaming far from civilization's fires and kitchens.

Eleanor Shackleton shares her surname with Pierce Shackleton and Samantha Shackleton, who live in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. Family names can be the only tether an undead person has to mortal life in the shattered remnants of Lordaeron. Whether Eleanor, Pierce, and Samantha are close kin or share only common ancestry, each serves the Forsaken in a distinct way across the blighted kingdom.
